title: Fried halloumi with caraway cabbage and beans

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a whole food or a plain staple such as tinned butter beans, halloumi, honey and cider vinegar.

supermarket.reason: Everything is a standard Tesco line at an everyday price, with 450g of halloumi being two ordinary blocks.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, board and large frying pan, and simple frying technique.

works.reason: Half a cabbage, two tins of beans and 450g halloumi make a sensible dinner for four, with clear heat, timings and balanced sweet, sour and salty seasoning.

honest_times.reason: Shredding half a cabbage and slicing an onion, two apples and the halloumi fits 15 minutes, and the 10 plus 5 plus 4 minutes of cooking matches the 20 printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including the caraway, lemon and honey, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm, browned white cabbage with apple and caraway is the bulk of the plate and suits a cold late-December evening.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling meal of vegetables, pulses and cheese that a family would happily eat again.
